title: Orlov's Landau-Ginzburg / Calabi-Yau Equivalence on the Locked Three-Chain Sextic Fourfold V(F) in Lean 4

description: Preprint (orlov_equivalence_VF.pdf) and Lean 4 formalization (Orlov/Equivalence.lean) applying Orlov's 2009 theorem (Triangulated categories of singularities and equivalences between Landau-Ginzburg models, Theorem 2.13) to the smooth three-chain sextic Calabi-Yau fourfold Y = V(F) ⊂ P^5 with F = Σ (x_i^5 x_{i+3} + x_{i+3}^6) (degree d=6=N=5+1, Gorenstein parameter a=0), establishing the exact triangulated equivalence D^b(coh V(F)) ≅ HMF^{gr}(A, F) while documenting why this equivalence does not produce a second projective fourfold or an algebraic cycle outside Q<h^2, [Π]>.
